title: Welded beam
description: A straight beam of any size, welded from laser-cut plate (1 to 10 mm, steel or aluminium) that locates itself by tab and slot: four walls, bulkheads and end plates, so the laser's flatness and accuracy carry over into a beam to build machines from (a CNC router's gantry and frame). Choose for each long edge which plate lies on which; tabs into thick plate stop short for a plug weld, tabs into thin plate go through to be fused; every slot has T-bone reliefs and every tab root a dogbone. The outputs give the section (measured on the model), weight, deflection, stresses, twist, plate buckling and the first natural frequency for the load you set. Export each plate with File > Export..., DXF or SVG, with the face sets "Cut: ..." (one per part: the plates may differ in thickness); STEP exports the whole beam.
author: 3DCraft Jigs
